memory_rules.agent_solution: max(tensor walk, every tensor/array/buffer payload the solution kept alive anywhere in the process, live CUDA bytes, peak CUDA bytes during the phase), measured after compress and again after inference; baseline sized the same way with one forward pass. Protocol revision `dream_rsi.evaluator.memory_rule+prompt`; evaluator commit 49507417b3252530e7f67ccf7fa0fb665c26510a, merged in f2dba2e.
memory_rules.recipe: resident tensor storage from `storage_inventory` (benchmark phase where present, else screen), the quantity the recipe runs record. Not the agent-solution rule; the table below names the rule per row.

rule.selection_data: development phase only; no reserved episode existed when this record was written
steps: The uncompressed reference B16 is always selected as the paired control.

A Dream-RSI node is selected when it has a valid score under the fixed memory rule, passes the development gate (>= 77/100) and is not one of the three cycle-3 exploit nodes. Both qualifying nodes are selected; neither dominates the other (84/100 at 81.6 % removed versus 80/100 at 83.0 % removed).

Precision-surface reserved cells are the cells of the pre-registered reserved queue `queue-reserved.json`, applied as written: B16, precision-lang-int8, precision-lang-nf4, ladder-nf4-graph-1step-packed. That file instantiates the plan's reserved rule (`precision_surface_plan.json`: reserved trials only after a deployment recipe is frozen) and the README reading that Q8/Q4 reuse the decoder INT8/NF4 arms and the packed NF4 one-step ladder is the deployment stand-in. No cell is added.
Joint recipes C1/C2 are defined by development outcomes in the plan and are not authored. They are not run and no reserved cell is invented for them.
No candidate is added by taste. Cells outside the reserved queue are not selected however well they scored in development.
rule.statistics: Wilson 95 % per arm; task-stratified paired bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 42) against B16 on identical task/state/seed keys. Development and reserved stay in separate columns and are never pooled.
